name: The Black thrones
overview: After the death of a powerful billionaire, twin heirs John and Jack Blackthorne are stunned to learn that their inheritance depends on marrying Evangeline Herrera, the daughter of their late father’s caretaker. While kind-hearted John quickly falls in love with Eva, the ambitious Jack is determined to win her at any cost, even manipulating her mother with promises of wealth. Torn between family pressure and genuine love, Eva must decide whether to follow her heart or sacrifice her happiness for those she loves.
